column1: # The clips the game plays, cut from sources/ by make.py into src/nfm/lit/features/sounds/<name>.wav.
# start and seconds are within the file in sources/. rate is the game's: its own effects are 8000 to 22050 Hz.
# kind: shot (played once; faded out over its last 30 ms) or loop (its end cross-faded into its start, 0.2 s).
# filter: an ffmpeg audio filter applied before resampling, or - for none.
